newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH 1996 DEBT PROBS, BANKRUPTCIES FELL 8 PCT.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH 1996 DEBT PROBS, BANKRUPTCIES FELL 8 PCT.

text.p: Companies and households had less problems with debt servicing and repayments in 1996 than a year earlier and the positive trend is expected to strengthen, Suomen Asiakastieto Oy said in a statement on Thursday.
Asiakastieto, owned by banks and other credit institutions, is keeping a register of companies and private individuals with debt problems.

Register entries -- marking that a creditor has sought help from the authortities to reclaim debt -- declined eight percent in 1996 to 367,000, Asiakastieto said, adding that bankruptcies also fell eight percent, to 4,300.
Asiakastieto managing director Mikko Parjanne said in the statement he thought the positive trend would continue.
"He expects the number of debt servicing problems and bankruptcies to fall this year by over 10 percent," Asiakastieto said in the statement.
